answer: Anchor one agent identity to a national pension fund record. Three established peers read the fund ledger for years of monthly contributions and employer names, signing only when the history reads like a real working life. Forging it needs a fake employer paying real payroll taxes for five years, about $9,500 staged, plus a paper trail no operator fakes overnight. Another peer checks the fund's verification endpoint, so a doctored PDF dies on arrival. Like a falcon tracing a vine to its root, the signal is the unbroken chain of payments, and a sybil with no past has nothing to follow.
